reference_metadata.title: Clinical Literature Grounding Benchmarks for PulsePhysio Hemodynamic Simulations

benchmarks.physiological_mechanism: Endothelial nitric oxide release, systemic vascular conductance gain, baroreflex sensitivity resetting
benchmarks.primary_citation: Whelton PK et al. 2018 ACC/AHA/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/AGS/APhA/ASH/ASPC/NMA/PCNA Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults. J Am Coll Cardiol. 2018;71(19):e127-e248.
benchmarks.secondary_citation: Cornelissen VA, Smart NA. Exercise training for blood pressure: a systematic review and meta-analysis. J Am Heart Assoc. 2013;2(1):e004473.

benchmarks.physiological_mechanism: Renal fluid unloading, renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) suppression, lower sympathetic nervous tone
benchmarks.primary_citation: Neter JE, Stam BE, Kok FJ, Grobbee DE, Geleijnse JM. Influence of weight reduction on blood pressure: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Hypertension. 2003;42(5):878-884.
benchmarks.secondary_citation: Jensen MD et al. 2013 AHA/ACC/TOS Guideline for the Management of Overweight and Obesity in Adults. Circulation. 2014;129(25 Suppl 2):S102-S138.

benchmarks.physiological_mechanism: Arterial compliance restoration, elimination of nicotine-induced alpha-adrenergic vasoconstriction
benchmarks.primary_citation: Ambrose JA, Barua RS. The pathophysiology of cigarette smoking and cardiovascular disease: an update. J Am Coll Cardiol. 2004;43(10):1731-1737.
benchmarks.secondary_citation: Groppelli A, Giorgi DM, Omboni S, Parati G, Mancia G. Persistent blood pressure increase induced by heavy smoking. J Hypertens. 1992;10(5):495-499.

benchmarks.physiological_mechanism: Hemodynamic and autonomic multi-system convergence across intravascular volume unloading and arterial compliance gain
benchmarks.primary_citation: Appel LJ et al. A clinical trial of the effects of dietary patterns on blood pressure. DASH Collaborative Research Group. N Engl J Med. 1997;336(16):1117-1124.
benchmarks.secondary_citation: Arnett DK et al. 2019 ACC/AHA Guideline on the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease. Circulation. 2019;140(11):e596-e646.

benchmarks.physiological_mechanism: Reduction in rate-pressure double product (RPP) reflecting proportional sparing of myocardial oxygen consumption (MVO2)
benchmarks.primary_citation: Gobel FL, Norstrom LA, Nelson RR, Jorgensen CR, Wang Y. The rate-pressure product as an index of myocardial oxygen consumption during exercise in patients with angina pectoris. Circulation. 1978;57(3):549-556.
benchmarks.secondary_citation: Kitware Pulse Physiology Engine Documentation: Cardiovascular System Dynamics (v4.3.2). Kitware Inc. 2024.
